card.name: Inside names starting with B-r-e
card.fires_on: The piece 'ree', 'REE' or 'rie' right after a leading B in a name or word, and 'FA' inside the brand name BYFAVO. It fires partway through such names, such as Breeam, Bree, Elbree, Embree and breech.

modes.label: B + ree in names
modes.description: The 'ree' or 'REE' piece after an initial B in a person, building or brand name.
